data.name: Starstride
data.detailed_description:
The Battle of Racial Struggle is on the verge of outbreak

Cross Star and Race Survival Battle! The hope of ending interstellar drift and continuing the race's lifeline through competition!

Who can fully embrace 'Tral' as a new human or awakened or indigenous?

Extreme Fingertip Operation For Superburn Battle

Unlocking hot blood thrill, burning the cosmic soul in your heart!

Multiple weapons+FTG skill combos, unleashing your operational potential.

Diy Combination to Create Exclusive Mecha

Exclusive equipment, dazzling skills, and multi style sets, freely paired with your heart.

Build a mech that only you can control, and a galaxy level powerhouse is about to be born!

Free to Pinch Your Face and Write Your story

Personalized section+shaping slider, various styles of customized face kneading,

From skin tone and facial features to hair and voice, the protagonist of science fiction stories is defined by you.

Interstellar Adventures Explore the Mysterious Realm

The super giant demon beast descended from a foreign land, a mysterious pusher in the underworld.

What Are they? Why Did You Come Here Again?

Challenging new species, exploring giant maps, and searching for unknown treasures, your journey is a sea of stars!

[Note from the Developer]

Hi! I'm Li Wanglin, the producer of "Starstride". It's a pleasure to meet you all!

"Starstride" is a mobile game that inherits the classic MMO gameplay of desktop games. As a small development team of less than twenty people, our dream is to enable mobile gamers to experience the authentic large-scale MMORPG gameplay on their mobile devices. To this end, we have invested a lot of effort and expertise in areas such as graphics and special effects, map editing, and gameplay variety. We hope players will enjoy this product.

In our game, we have crafted a brand-new 3D action combat system with high degrees of freedom. Players can freely customize their moves with weapon switching, vital point destruction, and awakening finishing moves. Unique back weapons can even unlock exclusive skills. Players can switch between "melee" and "ranged" modes in battle, using cold weapons or light machine guns to tackle diverse and challenging boss battles. They can also summon "drones" to perform special functions such as throwing grenades. The game supports multiplayer teaming, making team tactics the key to victory. Players can freely customize their characters' faces and outfit with luxurious mecha fashion. By freely exploring and battling on the large map, collecting different materials, forging equipment, upgrading core inscriptions to strengthen combat power, entering rift dungeons, participating in faction PVP to vie for glory, and enjoying a comprehensive guild and friend system that helps them meet comrades-in-arms to confront crises together, players can explore and battle freely. The game supports multi-terminal interconnection, competitive gaming, and teaming on mobile phones/computers, allowing players from different platforms to embark on expeditions together.

We hope that all loyal fans of MMORPG games will journey forward with us in the “Starstride” in 2026, and reap their own share of passion and emotion on the planet Telar.

data.short_description: You need to decide the faction you are born into and fight for it, gradually becoming the most powerful Star Warrior. Power armor and energy core will be one of the most important cores that accompany players' growth. You can freely create your own mecha set and conquer the entire vast universe.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows7
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-4150 CPU @ 3.50GHz 350 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: windows10

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12288MB)
